links.what: ALGAR, the Algarve's waste operator, built EcoRouteAI with the Portuguese AI startup NILG.AI to choose sites for recycling points.
links.ai_path: The tool is machine learning on collection records and street and satellite imagery.
links.source_title: EcoRouteAI: Otimizacao de Ecopontos com Inteligencia Artificial (NILG.AI)

to.name: Lagoa and Sao Bras de Alportel (pilot municipalities)

links.what: The pilots were run in Lagoa and Sao Bras de Alportel; the article says the plan is to expand across the Algarve.
links.ai_path: An AI product piloted in two councils' areas.

links.what: Ambiente Online reports the tool is developed under Sociedade Ponto Verde's Re-Source 3.0 programme and that ALGAR leads the project (16 Algarve municipalities served since 1995).
links.ai_path: The programme funds an AI tool.
links.source_title: Inovacao com IA na otimizacao de ecopontos aumenta reciclagem no Algarve (Ambiente Online)

links.what: Witflow is described as a collaboration between Flow Productions and Witfy, an AI platform for content planning and distribution; it helps brands be found on search engines and AI platforms.
links.ai_path: Witflow sells visibility on AI platforms and uses Witfy's AI platform.
links.source_title: Algarve-based startup Witflow selected for incubation at Unicorn Factory Lisbon (Sul Informacao)

links.what: Selected for the Spring 2026 incubation; Unicorn Factory Lisboa is a Lisbon City Hall initiative from 2022. Witflow says it works from the Algarve (town not stated in what was read).
links.ai_path: An AI-visibility startup in a national incubator.

links.what: A Faro digital agency launched an AI Hub in February 2025 (chat and voice assistants, agents for internal processes, AI-first products with startups). Sectors named by the company: real estate, tourism, e-commerce, fintech. These are the company's own claims.
links.ai_path: The company sells AI automation to firms.
links.source_title: Dengun lanca hub de Inteligencia Artificial (Sul Informacao)

links.what: A directory and search extract list a Dengun startup studio at the UALG TEC Campus in Faro. Weak source; to confirm on the campus or company page.
links.ai_path: An AI agency tied to the university's tech campus.

to.name: NERA, Associacao Empresarial da Regiao do Algarve

links.what: In 2022 the summit opened at the University of the Algarve's Campus da Penha (Faro) and continued the next day at NERA in Loule, so it ties Faro's university to Loule's business association. Algarve Evolution, Algarve STP, CCDR Algarve and the national innovation agency took part in the opening. AI appeared as a theme in one talk only: an old edition, not 2026.
links.ai_path: A technology summit with AI as one theme.
links.source_title: Algarve Tech Hub Summit arrancou para impulsionar a inovacao na regiao algarvia (Barlavento)

leads.what: Dengun's CEO and a representative of Algarve Evolution at the 2022 summit opening have the same name in two sources (Sul Informacao 2025, Barlavento 2022). If it is the same person, Dengun (Faro) is linked to Algarve Evolution through a public professional role. Not confirmed; no name is recorded here until confirmed.
Algarve Tech Hub Summit 2026: an Instagram post says dates soon; a Barlavento page dated 2026 describes a Loule/NERA edition but its text matches 2022. Not claimed.

DevFest 2026 (GDG Faro, Campus da Penha) on 27 and 28 November per a Barlavento search extract; place.faro@ lists it. Also ULS Algarve conference on 14 October with an AI block, and an ACRAL session on AI for SMEs on 20 January 2026 in Faro.

Other Algarve AI names seen in a search extract, not yet read at source: Invisible CFO (fintech), Visualforma (smart cities), Algarve 2030 funds for 15 tourism SMEs adopting AI and robotics, Microsoft and UAlg executive AI course.
